description: The view now shows these tabs, in this order, with this one in front: a container that holds it can draw them in place of the view's own single tab.

view.description: The address (4.1) of the view that shows the tabs.

tabs.description: The view's tabs, in the order they are shown.

id.description: What the tab stands for, as the view names it.

closable.description: The user may close this tab.

active.description: The id of the tab in front, or null when there is none.
